description: Convert a document (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, CSV, JSON, TXT or MD) to clean Markdown with headings, lists, tables and links preserved, ready to feed to an AI chat or a notes app. Input: the file's contents as a base64-encoded string plus file_name (its extension declares the format and is verified against the content; max 25 MB, PDFs max 500 pages). Important: the document must contain a real text layer - scanned or image-only PDFs return an error because this tool does not run OCR, and failed calls are not charged. Returns a download_url for the .md file (link valid 24 hours) plus the character count. Costs 1 credit; 5 free calls per month.

file_base64.description: The document's contents as a base64-encoded string (max 25 MB; PDFs max 500 pages). The document must contain a real text layer - scanned or image-only files are rejected because this tool does not run OCR.
file_base64.title: File Base64

file_name.description: The file's name with its real extension, e.g. report.docx or paper.pdf. The extension declares the format and is verified against the content.
file_name.title: File Name
